annotations.title: Spiegel mit & ohne Rahmen finden Sie bei Höffner online
Spiegel kaufen » Jetzt im ROLLER Online-Shop

content.text:
If you mean the **old Spiegel catalog retailer** in the U.S., it does **not appear to have an active official “Spiegel Home” online catalog** today. Spiegel was historically a mail-order/catalog retailer selling apparel and home goods, but current search results mostly show historical references rather than an active Spiegel shopping site. ([encyclopedia.com](https://www.encyclopedia.com/economics/economics-magazines/spiegel-group?utm_source=openai))

If you’re trying to shop for **home items like mirrors** — “Spiegel” means “mirror” in German — current online options include:

- **home24** for mirrors and home décor ([home24.de](https://www.home24.de/garderobenspiegel/?utm_source=openai))  
- **Westwing** for decorative wall mirrors ([westwing.de](https://www.westwing.de/spiegel/wandspiegel/?utm_source=openai))  
- **Höffner** for entryway/garderobe mirrors ([hoeffner.de](https://www.hoeffner.de/garderoben-spiegel?utm_source=openai))  
- **ROLLER** for budget mirrors and furniture ([roller.de](https://www.roller.de/moebel/spiegel/?utm_source=openai))  

If you meant **vintage Spiegel catalogs**, you may need archive sites, eBay, Etsy, or collector marketplaces rather than a current shopping catalog.
